extra.reason: Added --debug-passes with pre/post-optimization IR and lowered machine instruction output, documented and tested.
Added --asm mode, documented its disassembly semantics, and verified binary/debug modes remain functional.
Replaced manual parsing with clap and added IR dumps, verification, optimization levels, timings, stats, assembly output, and objdump mode.
Implemented temporary print and exit builtins with lexer/parser/codegen modules and span-based diagnostics.
Nassau now accepts the Basis-qualified POSIX exit form and integration tests compare stdout and status against MLton.
The oracle test now discovers each .sml fixture under tests/fixtures and compares each against MLton.
Added a shared Cranelift code-generation path with a JIT-backed REPL frontend for supported SML chunks.
Nassau now starts the REPL with no source argument and compiles when given a file path.
REPL-mode parsing now accepts bare print and POSIX exit expressions while file parsing remains declaration-only.
Added named integer bindings and addition, persistent REPL bindings, and three-way end-to-end comparisons against MLton.
Added a dedicated configurable SML/NJ REPL integration harness and removed REPL execution from the MLton compiled-executable test.
Added - * / with multiplicative precedence and matching signed Cranelift operations, plus oracle fixture coverage.
Added real literals and f64 arithmetic with real-only slash division, retained integer div, and covered REPL results plus the SML/MLton fixture.
Added a stateful Analyzer with scope operations, transactional environment updates, centralized type checking for arithmetic and built-ins, and invoked it before code generation and REPL execution.
Semantic errors are now structured enum variants with preserved source spans.
SemanticError now wraps a SemanticErrorKind enum alongside one source span, with tuple From conversion for located errors.
SemanticError is now a location-free enum; main and REPL construct a separate source diagnostic using the offending expression span.
Replaced granular parser expectation variants with Expect(String)
Added relational operators with sema validation, Cranelift lowering, and SML/NJ-backed REPL fixtures
Implemented >=, <=, and <> through lexer, parser, sema, codegen, and SML/NJ-backed REPL fixtures
Updated project instructions to permit one-line task-end commits and prohibit remote pushes
Added Boolean literals and typed if-then-else expressions through all execution paths
Implemented list literal parsing, recursive list typing/inference, and fixture-based SML/NJ/MLton frontend coverage; list execution is covered by the dependent runtime ticket.
Implemented heap-backed list values for compiled programs and persistent JIT REPL chunks; valid and invalid fixture status coverage passes.
Registered each SML fixture as an independent parallel test trial
List type fixtures now run through the recursive parallel fixture harness
